invalid_input.zh-Hans: 请拖入一个 PDF 文件

opened_detail.en:
Copy: %s
In Preview, open Markup > Signature. Create a handwritten signature with the trackpad, camera, or iPhone/iPad, then press Command-S to save.
opened_detail.zh-Hans:
副本：%s
在“预览”中打开“标记”→“签名”，可用触控板、摄像头或 iPhone/iPad 创建手写签名；完成后按 Command-S 保存。

preview_failed.en: Could not open the signature copy in Preview.
preview_failed.zh-Hans: 无法用“预览”打开签名副本

action.script:
set -euo pipefail

src="${NOTCH_FILE:-}"
if [[ -z "$src" || ! -f "$src" || "${src:e:l}" != "pdf" ]]; then
  print -u2 -- "$(notch_t invalid_input)"
  exit 1
fi

dir="${src:h}"
filename="${src:t}"
stem="${filename:r}"
suffix="$(notch_t copy_suffix)"
dest="$dir/${stem}-${suffix}.pdf"
index=2
while [[ -e "$dest" ]]; do
  dest="$dir/${stem}-${suffix}-${index}.pdf"
  (( index += 1 ))
done

/bin/cp -p "$src" "$dest"
if ! /usr/bin/open -b com.apple.Preview "$dest"; then
  /bin/rm -f "$dest"
  print -u2 -- "$(notch_t preview_failed)"
  exit 1
fi

detail="$(printf "$(notch_t opened_detail)" "${dest:t}")"
notch_result \
  --summary "$(notch_t opened_summary)" \
  --details "$detail" \
  --output "$dest" \
  --effect-json '{"preset":"success-glow"}'
